youronlinechoices.name: YourOnlineChoices (EDAA)
youronlinechoices.notes: EU one-shot for interest-based ads. File first. Not a full erasure of credit files.

acxiom.name: Acxiom
acxiom.notes: EU/UK consumer rights portal. Blind opt-out is the default. Fall back to AskPrivacy@acxiom.com with the GDPR letter.

criteo.name: Criteo
criteo.notes: Art. 17 erasure + withdraw consent. Use the rights page; email DPO if the form blocks.

liveramp.name: LiveRamp
liveramp.notes: Identity-graph / marketing connectivity. Use their rights page.

oracle_ads.name: Oracle Advertising
oracle_ads.notes: BlueKai / addthis lineage. Privacy-choices page or privacy_ww@oracle.com. GDPR Art. 17/21.

google_results.name: Google — results about you
google_results.notes: Delist personal contact info from Search. Not a broker; it is what people actually see.

dnb.name: Dun & Bradstreet
dnb.notes: Opt out only if a person/director page is found. Company pages stay.

schufa.name: SCHUFA
schufa.notes: German credit file. ID / Postident. Digest only. Student sends later if they live in DE.

experian.name: Experian
experian.notes: Credit bureau. ID gated in most EU countries. Digest only.

crif_eu.name: CRIF (EU)
crif_eu.notes: Credit bureau (IT and others). ID gated. Digest only.
